cmake

# clang/llvm
clang-tools-14
libclang-14-dev

# These packages are for libodb, needed for the database backend

odb

libodb-pgsql-dev

# libjsoncpp needed for fbi json parsing

libjsoncpp-dev

# You need this for the lava.proto file
protobuf-compiler

libprotobuf-c-dev
